body:
Update README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, USAGE.md, and docs/usage.md to reflect major runtime modernizations:
1. Antigravity 1.2.8+ stream-json structured output, schema validation, streaming watchdog byte/line caps.
2. ADLC 1.11.1+ integration: adlc merge-forecast --graph-coupling, adlc ticket doctor in agb doctor, project-local authenticated binary resolution.
3. Platform sandbox hardening: Linux Bubblewrap (bwrap) read-only root, masked host credentials, Windows AppContainer with active differential syscall probing and attestation nonces, approved executable cache staging (~/.adlc/pinned/).
4. Dual-pool quota routing with Gemini 3.8/3.7 models.
5. Explicit comparison section in README.md detailing the differences, benefits, and tradeoffs between antigravity-booster (agb) and Antigravity's built-in /boost slash command (https://antigravity.google/docs/boost/).
6. Clean up hardcoded macOS file:/// paths in markdown documentation to portable relative links.

Acceptance criteria:
- README.md contains a clear, comprehensive comparison table and narrative for agb vs built-in /boost.
- Documentation reflects Linux bwrap and Windows AppContainer capabilities and environment variables.
- All tests pass (npm test).
- Rails guard passes cleanly.
title: Update documentation for agy 1.2.8 / adlc 1.11.1 and add booster vs built-in /boost comparison
